description: This file defines the interface ITextElement, which is part of the PhpSpreadsheet library's RichText component. It declares methods for getting and setting text, retrieving font information, and obtaining a hash code, serving as a contract for classes that implement text elements.

classes.name: ITextElement
classes.description: An interface representing a text element in RichText, defining methods for text manipulation and formatting.

methods.name: getText
methods.description: Returns the text content of the element.

methods.name: setText
methods.description: Sets the text content of the element. Returns the instance for chaining.

methods.name: getFont
methods.description: Retrieves the font style applied to the text element, or null if not set.

methods.name: getHashCode
methods.description: Returns a hash code representing the current state of the text element.
